description: MainActivity.java is a primary launcher activity demonstrating runtime permission handling in an Android app. It manages requesting permissions for camera and contacts, shows fragments based on permission status, and handles permission result callbacks.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity demonstrates handling runtime permissions, UI interactions, and fragment transactions for camera and contacts features.

methods.name: showCamera
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'Show camera' button is pressed. Checks for camera permission and requests it if necessary, or shows the camera preview.

methods.name: requestCameraPermission
methods.description: Requests camera permission and shows rationale via Snackbar if needed.

methods.name: showContacts
methods.description: Handles the event when the 'Show contacts' button is pressed. Checks permissions for contacts and requests if needed, or shows contact details.

methods.name: requestContactsPermissions
methods.description: Requests contact permissions with rationale if needed.

methods.name: showCameraPreview
methods.description: Displays CameraPreviewFragment if camera permission is granted.

methods.name: showContactDetails
methods.description: Displays ContactsFragment if contact permissions are granted.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Callback for processing permission request results, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain to display logs on the device screen.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets content view, and performs initial setup including logging and fragment transaction.

methods.name: onBackClick
methods.description: Handles back button to pop fragment back stack.
